ns2:section.sectionText: For Spring 2010: experiments include VIRTUAL REALITY (3D skiing & motion perception), PRISM ADAPTION (see the world upside-down with inversion goggles), VISUAL ILLUSIONS (slope illusion), and ATTENTION (visual search). For more information and prerequisites see https://netfiles.uiuc.edu/wang18/www/334f09.htm or contact instructor (Frances Wang, wang18@illinois.edu). All seats reserved for Psychology majors until January 15th. Seniors priority enrollment begins November 3rd. Juniors priority enrollment begins November 11th. Sophomores priority enrollment begins November 13th.
